claim: Walmart had no less than $7.7 billion of operating income in fiscal 2026 Q4.
summary: Walmart fiscal 2026 Q4 ends Jan 31, 2026, which is after the knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04 and would not have been reported by then. Without tools and limited to cutoff knowledge, no established operating income value for that quarter is available to verify the >=$7.7 billion claim.

sub_claims.text: Walmart had operating income of at least $7.7 billion in fiscal 2026 Q4
sub_claims.stated_text: Walmart had no less than $7.7 billion of operating income in fiscal 2026 Q4
sub_claims.note: As of cutoff 2026-01-04, Walmart fiscal 2026 Q4 (Nov 2025-Jan 2026) was not complete and not reported; no verified value is available within cutoff knowledge to confirm or contradict without tools.
